note: Sample people for the demo build (dist/vetbuddy-demo.html). Invented; any resemblance to a real person is accidental. Each one feeds the real Mission Router (router) and the real Benefit Vault matcher (vault_facts); scripts/build_web.py runs both and nothing here states an outcome.

people.name: Dana
people.headline: Army National Guard sergeant in Alabama, leaving in about eight months
people.story: Drills with the Alabama Guard, works full time, wants to finish a degree and line up a civilian job before her contract ends. Not sure what authority her last orders were under.

people.name: Marcus
people.headline: Navy veteran in Texas, rated 100% permanent and total
people.story: Separated about a year ago after 12 years, honorable discharge, Gulf War-era service. Settling near family in Texas and wants to know what the state offers for property tax, licenses and school for his kids.

people.name: Ana
people.headline: Surviving spouse in Virginia; her husband died on active duty
people.story: Her husband, a Marine, died in the line of duty. She is raising two children in Virginia and wants to understand education help for them and what she can still use herself.

people.name: Jordan
people.headline: Air Force spouse, stationed in Florida, legal residence in Washington
people.story: Moved to Florida with an active-duty spouse. Still a Washington resident for taxes and voting, and wants to know what applies where, including hunting and fishing licenses and state parks.
